LanguageData.GR_AgePills.description:
These capsules are filled with a mixture of chemicals and nanomachines, able to modify an organism's age by carefully manipulating its DNA. Every pill taken increases age by 1 year. Useful to make animals mature quickly.

Once consumed, the animal will be extremely dizzy for at least a day, and additional pills administered during that period won't be effective.

Oh, your colonists can also consume them...
LanguageData.GR_AgePills.label: age pills
LanguageData.GR_AvianGenetrainer.description: Directly injects avian genes in an humanoid. This genetrainer gives the birdlike curiosity health state, increasing global learning speed.\n\nGenetrainers are implants that do not take the place of any given organ. Only one can be "installed" at a time. Using a second genetrainer will have no effect. Bear in mind that a genetrainer modifies the genes of the human subject, and only death will get rid of its effects.
LanguageData.GR_AvianGenetrainer.label: avian genome genetrainer

LanguageData.GR_GenderSelectorMajor_Female.descriptio:
A fertility booster that also forces the produced embryo to develop female characteristics. Effectively allows hybrids to reproduce with the exact same species.

This booster can't be crafted, only scavenged.

Note: Insectoid hybrids are always incapable of reproducing.
